name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaah, I’m sooooo tired……」
After the match, I shared the joy with Muragaki-sensei for a while. Now, I’m heading to the locker room to change.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I actually beat Victoria-senpai……」
Of course, I’d been working hard with the intention of winning all this time, and I went into that match planning to beat her.
But now that it’s actually happened, it feels completely unreal.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But winning in the semifinals... that means I’ve made it into the top two in this academy, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ughhh, thinking about it like that is kind of scary.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What if the third-years from the Martial Arts Division call me out after the Martial Festival and beat me to a pulp?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like, ‘Hey there, so you’re the first-year brat who was getting cocky at the Martial Festival, huh? Lend us your face for a sec！’ or something.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A picture of Setsugekka getting ganged up on and ‘taught a lesson’ by the third-years……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, that sounds so likely！ Totally likely！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「This is bad, this is bad…… I’ve gotta talk to Muragaki-sensei about this！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Yo, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kyaaaaaaah！ She appeared！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「……What are you so surprised about？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, isn't that Sono-chan-senpai！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hmm…… Setchin. You got a minute?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, yeah, I’m free, but...」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Then lend me your face for a bit.」

name: Setsugekka
message: （Eeeeek, it’s already happening！？）
After changing, I followed Sono-chan-senpai’s invitation and ended up at the embankment.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「U-um…… Sono-chan-senpai?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Yeah, what is it?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If it’s possible, I’d really appreciate it if you didn't dump me in the ocean. I’d surely die if you did that……」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh？ What are you talking about？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aren’t you here to rough up a first-year brat for getting too cocky？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, come on... What do you even take me for?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A delinquent.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, talk about blunt!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You're not？ Then why are we in a place like this？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「W-Well, I mean... it's just, I didn't really want people watching, y'know?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, I suppose witnesses would get in the way of beating me up...」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I'm telling you, that's not it!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I just... I just wanted to talk to you, that's all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, is that right?」
Sono-chan-senpai looks somewhat bashful.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Uh... well, y'know.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Back when Kuki Asahi and I were having our match, you yelled something, didn't you?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, you heard that？！」
It was pretty loud all around us, so I'd thought it hadn't reached her ears.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Yeah, loud and clear.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, um, you've got it all wrong？！ I wasn't trying to taunt you or anything, Sono-chan-senpai！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Yeah, I know.」
Sono-chan-senpai, smiling gently with a soft chuckle.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Seriously, how'd you even manage to shout that loud? Woke me right up, thanks to you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm sorry... A bunch of stuff had me really frustrated, so I ended up yelling at the top of my lungs.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「A bunch of stuff? What happened?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「While I was watching the match from the stands, some Martial Arts Division student—I don't know who—was talking trash about you, Senpai.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「They were calling you uncool, Sono-chan-senpai, and it just ticked me off so much.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I think you're cool, Sono-chan-senpai, so I kind of, um, wanted to hurl my burning pathos straight at you.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Pfft...」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Heh, ahahahahahaha! Man, you really are one hilarious piece of work!!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahaha... Well, I'm honored if I could entertain you.」
We laughed heartily together there on the embankment.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Thanks, Secchin.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Your cheering really hit home.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sono-chan-senpai...」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That's all I wanted to tell you. Later.」
Leaving those words behind, Sono-chan-senpai turned her back to me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Oh, right.」
She suddenly stopped in her tracks and turned her face back toward me.

name: Sonomi
message: 「I watched your whole match earlier.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That bit where you snatched the mic before the match? Man, that gave me chills. You're really starting to own that heel role, aren't ya?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You looked badass as hell out there, Secchin.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Th-Thank you so much, Master...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I told you to stop calling me Master.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Don't you dare lose in the finals.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Show 'em your guts and go wreck 'em！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, ma'am！！」
Hearing my reply, Sono-chan-senpai walked away with a satisfied look on her face.
